kicker: ai & minds · music nobody asked for
tagline: An AI that writes, plays and sings its own music on its own schedule. Pure numpy synthesis, a persistent sense of taste, and zero API keys required. You're the critic, not the director.
launchSub: Credentials required · hear what it made while nobody was listening
titleTail: an AI that makes music nobody asked for

story.label: the psyche
story.title: It has taste, and it gets bored of itself

lede:
muse keeps a persistent aesthetic self-model: trait weights for density, dissonance and brightness, and a fatigue level. When a trait stays satisfied too long, fatigue forces a deliberate self-violation and inverts the dominant trait for one piece. It's allowed to make something it will probably hate. That's the originality mechanism: a tediversion.

It runs on a schedule you don't set, keeps what clears its own bar, and purges the rest. Your verdicts move its taste slowly: about twelve consistent ones to shift a trait.

features.d: additive and FM synthesis in pure numpy at 32 kHz, and a formant-based singing voice instead of a TTS wrapper.
motifs transposed, inverted, played backwards and stretched; every piece keeps its lineage in SQLite.
keys only buy it words (briefs, titles, lyrics, reflections), routed through free tiers with local fallback. Cold start works fully offline.
73–80 MB of memory on an Android phone under Termux, about 56 seconds a render, pausing itself if it goes over budget.

cards.html: The runaway bar: a keep-rate controller could only ratchet up; it reached 0.84 and started destroying work scoring 0.72. It's now a quantile tracker bounded to [0.28, 0.78]. Equal peak isn't equal loudness: bass vanished and hats fizzed. Inverse A-weighting per note, filtered percussion and a master tilt fixed it, found by analysing a real rendered WAV.

scope: The live node is private. The page explains it; listening needs an invite. The voice is crude next to a neural vocoder, by choice.
closing: 2,369 lines. It keeps what clears its own bar.
